claims.text: The five-step loop registered in spec.md section 2 (explicit hypothesis sets including the absorbing verdicts; advance registration with falsifier, null, and control; ranking by expected information gain per unit cost with the sensitivity printed beside the ranking; blinded or held-out scoring wherever the test allows, under the five-rung preference order; a posterior trace with the supported / refuted / indeterminate / exhausted stopping rules) is the operating discipline of this study, and the five kill criteria of spec.md section 4 are registered with it. claims.text: At the Indus corpus profile, the program's structural statistics are identifiable (test I-1): under the registration filed at records/cycle-1-registration-2026-11-26.md section 2, two donor corpora of known structure (Meroitic from the pinned Kovetsky build; Latin from a pinned public-domain text), reshaped to the Indus profile (artifact count, token count, per-artifact length distribution, duplication rate) and ciphered, return, under the right-model condition, a G-IND-form predictor advantage and L3 positional-restriction recovery materially above the wrong-model and shuffle conditions, by the margins the registration fixes, at 1x scale. Does not establish: anything about the Indus language, its family, or any sign's value; the test calibrates what methods of the program's kind can extract from a corpus of this shape, on corpora whose structure is known; the Indus corpus itself is not scored by it.
